lines.text: Morning, desk crew! Mugsy is fully caffeinated and ready to judge.
Please, Mugsy. You're half empty and we all know it.
Can you two stop? I'm at 4 percent and very emotional.
Penelope, at least I'm not leaking ink on the homework.
That was ONE time. Ringo, back me up here!
I'm staying out of this. Somebody plug me in, please.
